Warlocks

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Warlocks

Warlocks are practitioners of pactmaking. They are trained, and use standardised ritual currencies for making deals with dark powers. Shamans also make pacts, although perhaps in a more ad hoc manner. |thumb|400px|Pactmaking http://darkclassics.blogspot.com.au/2013/03/william-fettes-douglas-spell.html]]
